A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same StelLA research. All 19 pages of each version, including equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–E, are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original fine-tuning experiments and ablations in Tables 1–6, qualitative generation results in Figure 1, and runtime measurements in Appendix D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including the benchmark comparisons, ablations, generated examples and appendix runtime measurements.

M1.justification: The three-factor adapter, Stiefel constraints, initialization, gradient scaling and optimization procedure in Algorithm 1 are unchanged. Equation edits only alter notation.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same commonsense reasoning, math and code generation, image classification and text-to-image tasks. The datasets and domains represented in Tables 1–4 are unchanged.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain identical comparator sets, including the seven baselines in Table 1 and LoRA, DoRA and PiSSA in Tables 2–4. PoLAR is newly discussed but is not experimentally evaluated.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix C retain the same model configurations, adapter placements, ranks, training budgets, evaluation metrics and learning-rate settings. No experimental protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: Tables 5–6 retain the same analyses of geometry, initialization, gradient scaling, parallel transport and retraction. Figure 1's qualitative examples and Appendix D's solver and batching comparisons are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Tables 1–3 and 5–6 continue to report averages over three runs. Neither version adds different run-count information, seed disclosures, uncertainty estimates or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical results in Tables 1–6 and 11–12 and qualitative examples in Figure 1 match. For example, StelLA's commonsense averages remain 82.33 and 86.72, and its math/code average remains 39.30.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and derivations, including quotient geometry in Appendix B and scale stability in Appendix E, are unchanged. Removing transpose parentheses in Equation (2) and replacing superscript T with the transpose symbol around Equation (7) are equivalent notation changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about learning adapter subspaces, compatibility with existing optimizers and performance across tasks.

C2.justification: The result interpretations and mechanism explanations remain unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning computational overhead, combinations with other LoRA variants, and unevaluated model families and scales.

D1.justification: The code-access statement, optimizer-hook implementation, hyperparameter documentation and batched SVD details are retained. Appendices C–D provide the same learning rates, solver information, hardware and training times.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds PoLAR as concurrent work, noting its shared Stiefel constraints but contrasting its landing algorithm with infeasibility penalty against StelLA's retraction. One corresponding reference is added; the remaining research positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds a short related-work passage and makes small notation and bibliographic edits. The first-page publication notice changes from preprint status to NeurIPS 2025, while the section and appendix organization remains unchanged.

P2.justification: The added passage and reference cause limited page reflow, accompanied by small spacing changes and an updated first-page footer. All twelve tables and both figures retain their content and organization.

improvement.justification: Acknowledging PoLAR and explaining the optimization distinction modestly improves the completeness and precision of Section 2's research positioning. The method, empirical evidence, reproducibility information and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
